text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I have been out<n>walking for
quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We've gone a pretty long way. You<n>must be tired.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Since we still have plenty of time, why<n>don't we
take a break and have<n>some tea before heading
back?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
One of my favorite cafes is around<n>here, so let's go
there.
She leads the way to our destination.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's just past that corner over there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's strange...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They're closed, though they're<n>usually open at this
time...
choice_data_list: Maybe they're taking a day off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Perhaps. Well, let's try somewhere<n>else.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I heard a nice outdoor cafe just<n>opened down the
street.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been there yet, but this is<n>the perfect
opportunity to try it.

We arrive at a very fancy cafe with a<n>sign declaring
it to be owned and<n>managed by a celebrity barista.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a celebrity barista runs it? It's<n>no wonder
this menu is so elaborate.

This seems like a place for the<n>younger crowd.
There are dozens of<n>drinks to choose from, and the
selection of desserts is just as<n>varied.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing like the establishments<n>I usually
frequent, but it's the perfect<n>place to bring a friend.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It deserves a spot on my list, for sure.

With a highly skilled hand, Biwa<n>Hayahide writes
down the cafe's<n>name.
choice_data_list: Do you go to cafes often?
Do you go to cafes often?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sometimes with friends, and<n>sometimes just
by myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They're the perfect place to read a<n>book on a rainy
day.
choice_data_list: Can you recommend any other places?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They're the perfect place to read a<n>book on a rainy
day.
choice_data_list: Can you recommend any other places?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was merely looking for a<n>nice spot to read
at, but now it's<n>become something of a habit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Speaking of books, there's one<n>I'd like to
recommend to you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's an autobiography by a legendary
Umamusume...
She takes the book out from her bagalmost too nonchalantly.
choice_data_list:
...Do you always walk around with books in your
bag?

...Do you always walk around with books in your
bag?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes. I know it's rare in this age of<n>digitization, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think I've just gotten used to<n>having books in my
bag. It helps me<n>feel at peace.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Anyway, this book is quiteinteresting.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think you could learn a lot from it as<n>a trainer. Why
don't you give it a try?
I spend some time reading with Biwa<n>Hayahide...

While I'm at it, I gain some direct<n>insight into how
she hones her<n>intellect on a daily basis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But first, I need to know your criteria.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For example, do you plan to go<n>on a weekday
or the weekend? And<n>will you be there in the
morning,<n>afternoon, or evening?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do you plan to go by yourself or with<n>others?
Additionally, are you looking<n>for somewhere that
specializes in<n>food or in drink?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there are also the issues of<n>location and
how far you are willing to<n>travel.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The more information you can give<n>me, the more
well-equipped I'll be to<n>recommend you a place.

For a moment, I feel like I'm talking<n>with a real
estate agent because of<n>how detailed her inquiries
are.

But with her quick thinking and<n>analytical skills, she
really is able to<n>make the best possible
recommendation for me.
